rubrics.justification: Describes a plausible expanded blastocyst with thinning zona and moderate uncertainty in ICM/TE grading, but gives a broad speculative grade range and likely overstates precision from a single image.

Integrates age, BMI, PCOS, ovarian response, sperm quality, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo prognosis, though some statements about PCOS and aneuploidy are not strongly supported.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking morphology and favorable patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat optimistic probability and speculative morphology-based conclusions.

Mostly consistent with SET and general IVF practice, but assisted hatching is suggested too casually and discussion of ERA/immunologic/thrombophilia workup after failures is broader than guideline-supported routine use.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support review, cryopreservation, and future evaluation, though some recommendations remain somewhat generic.
